content:
Track: Data Manipulation with Python (Pandas)
    - Lesson 1: Introduction to Pandas Data Structures
    - Lesson 2: Reading and Writing Data with Pandas
    - Lesson 3: Basic Operations on Series and DataFrames
    - Lesson 4: Merging, Joining, and Concatenating DataFrames
    - Lesson 5: Filtering and Sorting Data in Pandas
    - Lesson 6: Group By and Aggregations with Pandas
    - Lesson 7: Reshaping Data using Melt and Pivot
    - Lesson 8: Handling Missing Values and Data Cleaning

   Track: Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) with Python
    - Lesson 1: Overview of EDA Techniques and Tools
    - Lesson 2: Descriptive Statistics in Python
    - Lesson 3: Visualizing Distributions using Histograms and Boxplots
    - Lesson 4: Correlation Analysis in Python
    - Lesson 5: Exploring Categorical Data with Count Plots and Bar Charts
    - Lesson 6: Time Series Analysis using Line and Area Charts
    - Lesson 7: Data Transformations and Outlier Detection
    - Lesson 8: Hypothesis Testing in Python (t-test, chi-square)

   Track: Machine Learning Foundations with Scikit-learn
    - Lesson 1: Introduction to Machine Learning Algorithms
    - Lesson 2: Supervised Learning and Evaluation Metrics
    - Lesson 3: Regression Analysis using Linear Regression
    - Lesson 4: Classification with Decision Trees and Random Forests
    - Lesson 5: Clustering Data using K-Means and Hierarchical Clustering
    - Lesson 6: Dimensionality Reduction with PCA and t-SNE
    - Lesson 7: Model Selection, Cross-Validation, and Hyperparameter Tuning
    - Lesson 8: Ensemble Methods and Model Interpretation

   Track: Statistical Inference with Python
    - Lesson 1: Introduction to Hypothesis Testing and Significance Level
    - Lesson 2: One-Sample t-Test
    - Lesson 3: Paired t-Test and Two-Sample t-Test
    - Lesson 4: Chi-Square Test for Independence
    - Lesson 5: ANOVA Analysis
    - Lesson 6: Confidence Intervals and Hypothesis Tests for Proportions
    - Lesson 7: Correlation and Regression Analysis
    - Lesson 8: Advanced Topics in Statistical Inference

   Track: Data Pipeline Development with Python (Airflow)
    - Lesson 1: Introduction to Airflow and DAGs
    - Lesson 2: Setting up an Airflow Environment
    - Lesson 3: Designing a Basic Data Pipeline
    - Lesson 4: Operators and Tasks in Airflow
    - Lesson 5: Scheduling and Triggering Tasks
    - Lesson 6: Error Handling and Retries in Airflow
    - Lesson 7: Integrating with Cloud Storage Services (S3, GCS)
    - Lesson 8: Monitoring and Troubleshooting Data Pipelines

   Track: SQL Advanced Queries
    - Lesson 1: Subqueries and Joins with EXISTS and NOT EXISTS
    - Lesson 2: Complex JOIN types (LEFT OUTER, RIGHT OUTER, FULL OUTER)
    - Lesson 3: Transactions, Locking, and Isolation Levels
    - Lesson 4: Advanced Aggregation Functions (RANK, DENSE_RANK, ROW_NUMBER)
    - Lesson 5: Window Functions (LAG, LEAD, FIRST_VALUE, LAST_VALUE)
    - Lesson 6: Common SQL Patterns and Anti-Patterns
    - Lesson 7: Performance Optimization Techniques in SQL
    - Lesson 8: Advanced Topics in Database Design

   Track: Data Storytelling with Python (Storyboard)
    - Lesson 1: Introduction to Data Storytelling and Visual Communication
    - Lesson 2: Setting up a Storyboard Project
    - Lesson 3: Creating Interactive Reports using Storyboard
    - Lesson 4: Designing Clear and Effective Visuals for Your Data
    - Lesson 5: Telling Compelling Stories with Data
    - Lesson 6: Incorporating Multiple Data Sources into Your Report
    - Lesson 7: Sharing and Presenting Your Reports using Storyboard
    - Lesson 8: Building a Portfolio of Data Stories
